# learn-eval

> A Claude Code Agent Skill (MIT) that extracts reusable patterns from a session, judges each one Save / Improve then Save / Absorb / Drop against a grounding checklist, and routes every kept pattern to a destination a future session actually reaches — absorbed into an existing skill, rule, or `hooks/README.md` section, or promoted to a real skill. There is no notes directory: if nothing would route to a pattern, its verdict is Drop.

Status: active, synced one way from the author's Claude Code harness by `scripts/sync-from-local.sh`, and also shipped in the [akc-cycle](https://github.com/shimo4228/akc-cycle) plugin, so this repository can trail the plugin between syncs. Requirements: Claude Code and `uv` on PATH (the overlap script needs Python 3.11+, standard library only); no paid key.

## Core documentation

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): self-contained Q&A reference for AI agents (Project Facts, Prior Research, question-form H2 sections)
- [README.md](README.md) / [README.ja.md](README.ja.md): human-facing narrative (English + Japanese)
- [SKILL.md](skills/learn-eval/SKILL.md): full skill specification — what to extract, the two destinations, the quality gate, the verdict flow, the reachability check
- [overlap_candidates.py](skills/learn-eval/scripts/overlap_candidates.py): evidence script that enumerates installed skills and MEMORY.md lines a draft may duplicate (JSON, no verdict)
- [akc-cycle](https://github.com/shimo4228/akc-cycle): Claude Code plugin that installs this skill as `/akc-cycle:learn-eval` together with `skill-creator` and the rest of the Agent Knowledge Cycle

## Architecture

- Two destinations, no parking lot: **Absorb** into an existing skill / rule / `hooks/README.md` section that owns the topic (default), or **Promote** to a skill with its own trigger via `skill-creator`. Neither fits → Drop
- Quality gate in three layers: overlap candidates from `overlap_candidates.py` (run through `uv`) → fixed checklist plus 3–5 draft-specific yes/no questions (no score aggregation) → one holistic verdict that lists every No as grounds
- 4 verdicts: **Save** (stands on its own → promote to a skill), **Improve then Save** (each No becomes an improvement item; one re-judgment with the same questions), **Absorb into [X]** (belongs inside an existing asset → append), **Drop**
- Confirmation one candidate at a time with `[y/n/skip]`, evidence first, never batch approval
- Reachability check after every Save: state what will route to the saved content; "someone would have to grep for it" means the Save was wrong
- Why the notes directory was retired: over 74 days the old `skills/learned/` notes were read during real work 12 times across 8 notes, while audits of the directory accounted for 161 of its 184 reads

- [skill-stocktake](https://github.com/shimo4228/skill-stocktake): quality audit for installed skills

- [llm-as-judge](https://github.com/shimo4228/llm-as-judge): the design pattern this skill's gate implements — binary checks as evidence, one named verdict, no aggregation
- [context-sync](https://github.com/shimo4228/context-sync): audits and fixes project documentation roles
- [search-first](https://github.com/shimo4228/search-first): look outside before deciding — returns a report the caller picks from
- [llms-txt-writer](https://github.com/shimo4228/llms-txt-writer): writes AI-facing docs such as this file
